description: Sub-leading substrate corrections to prop:flavor-split-substrate. Derivable (1 + ℏ_q³) closes -306 ppm; empirical (1 + (q-1)³) closes +51 ppm.

derivable_correction.status: derivable — follows from substrate brane-tower loop expansion
derivable_correction.justification_status: not yet justified by explicit categorical proof; deferred to substrate Li_2^q convergence analysis (PR #682 dep)
derivable_correction.reading: 3-loop substrate Planck (one more action quantum on top of leading 2-loop)

empirical_correction.status: NOT derivable from substrate machinery — q³ multiplier on top of ℏ_q³ lacks loop-expansion structure
empirical_correction.reading: tighter numerical match but ad hoc; could be a stronger categorical formula or a coincidence at q_0

data.status: Derivable correction (1+ℏ_q³) is the 3-loop substrate-Planck contribution — follows mechanically from the brane-tower loop expansion, closing -306 ppm.  *Derivable* != *justified*: a categorical proof of the exact coefficient is deferred to the substrate Li_2^q convergence analysis (PR #682 dep).  Empirical (1+(q-1)³) closes +51 ppm but its q³ multiplier on top of the derivable ℏ_q³ is NOT derivable from substrate machinery — either a stronger categorical formula or a numerical coincidence at q_0 (open research).
